## 1. Load and prep all quarters

```{r}
files <- list.files(
  path       = kampala_dir,
  pattern    = "ntl_[0-9]{4}_Q[1-4]_kampala\\.tif$",
  full.names = TRUE
) %>% sort()
```

```{r}
## Select a subset of files for testing
files_subset <- tail(files, 8)
```

```{r}
# 1. Load raster files
r_list <- lapply(files_subset, rast)

# 2. Create a multi-layer SpatRaster
r_stack <- terra::rast(r_list)

# 3. Assign quarter labels to layers
layer_names <- gsub("ntl_|_kampala\\.tif", "", basename(files_subset))
names(r_stack) <- gsub("_", " ", layer_names)

# 4. Extract spatial and temporal dimensions
nrow_k   <- terra::nrow(r_stack)
ncol_k   <- terra::ncol(r_stack)
n_cells  <- terra::ncell(r_stack)
T_layers <- terra::nlyr(r_stack)

# 5. Extract pixel-by-quarter matrix (without NA, matrix size is [n_cells x T_layers])
Y <- terra::values(r_stack)
```

## 2. Construction of Spatial and Temporal Penalty Matrices

```{r}
# 1. Build the spatial penalty matrix (D_space)
# This penalizes differences between adjacent pixels within the same quarter
rows_list <- c()
cols_list <- c()
vals_list <- c()
edge_counter <- 1

for (t in 1:T_layers) {
  offset <- (t - 1) * n_cells
  for (r in 1:nrow_k) {
    for (c in 1:ncol_k) {
      current_cell <- terra::cellFromRowCol(r_stack, r, c)
      current_idx <- offset + current_cell
      
      # Connect with right neighbor
      if (c < ncol_k) {
        right_cell <- terra::cellFromRowCol(r_stack, r, c + 1)
        right_idx <- offset + right_cell
        
        rows_list <- c(rows_list, edge_counter, edge_counter)
        cols_list <- c(cols_list, current_idx, right_idx)
        vals_list <- c(vals_list, 1, -1)
        edge_counter <- edge_counter + 1
      }
      
      # Connect with bottom neighbor
      if (r < nrow_k) {
        bottom_cell <- terra::cellFromRowCol(r_stack, r + 1, c)
        bottom_idx <- offset + bottom_cell
        
        rows_list <- c(rows_list, edge_counter, edge_counter)
        cols_list <- c(cols_list, current_idx, bottom_idx)
        vals_list <- c(vals_list, 1, -1)
        edge_counter <- edge_counter + 1
      }
    }
  }
}

# Create the sparse spatial penalty matrix
n_spatial_edges <- edge_counter - 1
D_space <- sparseMatrix(i = rows_list, j = cols_list, x = vals_list, 
                        dims = c(n_spatial_edges, n_cells * T_layers))
```

```{r}
# 2. Build the temporal penalty matrix (D_time)
# This penalizes differences for the same pixel between consecutive quarters
t_rows_list <- c()
t_cols_list <- c()
t_vals_list <- c()
t_edge_counter <- 1

for (t in 1:(T_layers - 1)) {
  offset_t1 <- (t - 1) * n_cells
  offset_t2 <- t * n_cells
  
  for (cell in 1:n_cells) {
    idx_t1 <- offset_t1 + cell
    idx_t2 <- offset_t2 + cell
    
    t_rows_list <- c(t_rows_list, t_edge_counter, t_edge_counter)
    t_cols_list <- c(t_cols_list, idx_t1, idx_t2)
    t_vals_list <- c(t_vals_list, 1, -1)
    t_edge_counter <- t_edge_counter + 1
  }
}

# Create the sparse temporal penalty matrix
n_temporal_edges <- t_edge_counter - 1
D_time <- sparseMatrix(i = t_rows_list, j = t_cols_list, x = t_vals_list, 
                       dims = c(n_temporal_edges, n_cells * T_layers))
```

```{r}
# Define the expected total number of coefficients
expected_p <- n_cells * T_layers

# Initialize beta as a vector of zeros with length expected_p
beta <- numeric(expected_p)

# Test to verify dimensions of penalty matrices and coefficient vector
stopifnot(ncol(D_time) == expected_p)
stopifnot(ncol(D_space) == expected_p)
stopifnot(length(beta) == expected_p) # Check expected coefficient vector length
```
